description: This file defines the AuthorizationServer class within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 middleware, responsible for managing OAuth2 authorization flows, grant types, token issuance, and security configurations.

classes.name: AuthorizationServer
classes.description: A class managing OAuth2 authorization processes, including grant type management, token handling, and security configurations within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AuthorizationServer with necessary repositories, cryptographic keys, and optional response type.

methods.name: setEncryptionKey
methods.description: Sets the encryption key used for securing tokens and communications.

methods.name: enableGrantType
methods.description: Enables a specific OAuth2 grant type with optional access token TTL.

methods.name: validateAuthorizationRequest
methods.description: Validates an incoming authorization request, ensuring it responds to a supported grant type.

methods.name: completeAuthorizationRequest
methods.description: Completes an authorization request, generating an HTTP response with authorization details.

methods.name: respondToAccessTokenRequest
methods.description: Processes an access token request, responding with a token or error.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the response type used for token responses.
